request.text: One original isolated close-up sound effect for a hand-painted insect-fantasy action game. No music, rhythm, melody, voices, speech, electronic alert beep or background ambience. Clean onset, natural physical detail, short controlled decay. A swift thin metal needle or scythe slicing air: sharp airy swish, fine edge hiss and a tiny cloth flutter. A weapon swing only, no impact or hit. Texture variation: tight and precise articulation.
